description: This file defines a Flutter provider class 'LibraryProvider' that manages the state of a library of books and search results. It handles loading books from storage, searching for books via a service, and updating the library list.

classes.name: LibraryProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-based class managing a collection of books (library), search functionality, and loading state within a Flutter application.

methods.name: loadLibraryFromDb
methods.description: Asynchronously loads books from storage into the local library list and notifies listeners.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search for books using the book service, manages loading state, and updates search results.

methods.name: addToLibrary
methods.description: Adds a new book to the library list, persists it via storage service, and notifies listeners.
